summary: A compact label for a value. Static to describe, toggleable as a filter chip, or removable to show selected values.
whenToUse: Filter chips above a table or a list: toggle tags in a labelled group.
Selected values in a multi-select Combobox or a filter bar: removable tags.
Static metadata: token groups, platforms, component categories.
whenNotToUse: Actions: use Button. A tag describes a value; it does not do something.
Choosing one option out of several: use RadioGroup or Tabs.

dos.title: Put filter chips in a named group
dos.text: role group with aria-label ("Filter by theme") tells screen reader users what the chips control.

donts.title: Sentences in tags
donts.text: Tags truncate. Keep them to a value of one to three words.

children: Tokens that changed since the last release

accessibility: Toggle tags are Base UI Toggle buttons with aria-pressed; selected also shows a check icon, so selection is not color alone.
The remove button is a separate button named "Remove <label>" (removeLabel when the text is not a plain string).
Both buttons have the focus ring and are reachable with Tab; Enter and Space activate them.
Static tags are plain text with no role.
contentGuidelines: Values as they appear elsewhere in the product: token paths in lowercase, names in sentence case.
After removing a tag, move focus to the next tag or back to the input.
